summary: Cass County, MN lookout labelled on a 1971 map; dismantled and re-erected at Hillview, Otter Tail County, in 1972. The FFLOS list marks the original site as gone.

facts.status_note: Original Boy River site is listed as gone. The dismantled tower was re-erected at Hillview in 1972; the Hillview page does not say whether it still stands there. The FFLOS list also marks a Hillview entry as gone, without naming which tower it means.
facts.agency: Minnesota Department of Natural Resources (re-erected the tower at Hillview)

notes_for_editor: Build date, design and staffing not found in the sources read. The Hillview page is undated and does not say whether the tower still stands there; check before publishing where it stands now. The FFLOS list's Hillview entry is marked gone but does not say which tower it refers to, so it is not taken as proof either way. The Hillview page also reports a 1976 toppling of a different tower near Sebeka, which is not this tower and is left out. The Cass County tower PDF on Wikimedia Commons does not list Boy River. The Pastmaps page is a map-site description (date portrayed 1971, published 1974); it is cited for the map label, the 1969 photography base, the settlement's setting, and the map's own description of the tower.
